episodes.title: Dr. Joseph Laycock on Cults (Q&A)
episodes.description:
We were able to talk to Dr. Joseph Laycock, an author and professor of religious studies that focuses on a wide variety of topics such his professional background, books, cults, misconceptions, shocking findings, difficulties in research, new findings, Ed and Lorraine Warren, WACO, the Atlanta Vampire Alliance, Yoga Cults, and more. 

To learn more about Dr. Laycock, check out https://faculty.txst.edu/profile/1922193
or view some his recent articles at 
https://religiondispatches.org/author...
